input.prompt: Original character design sheet for PEDOSTRZAL, a botanical defender in a premium mobile 2D tower-defense game. Create an ORIGINAL plant creature, not resembling any famous pea-shooter or existing game character. Non-humanoid rooted silhouette: sturdy curved green stem emerging from clustered leaves and visible roots, expressive small eyes integrated into the flower/seed-pod head, an organic seed-launching calyx made of layered petals and fibrous plant tissue rather than a tube or gun barrel. The attack should read as compressed seed pod pressure releasing a hard seed, with leaves flexing backward from recoil. Color palette: moss green, spring green, muted yellow seed core, small warm accents. Hand-painted/cartoon organic fantasy, whimsical but combat-ready, large readable silhouette at phone scale, clean top-down 3/4 orthographic game-art view, soft painterly shading, crisp focal edges, no sci-fi, no metal, no technology, no weapon parts, no text, no logo. Professional game studio sprite-source sheet on a simple warm off-white background. Show one large final hero pose plus 4 smaller consistent poses: idle, anticipation, seed-shot recoil, recovery. Keep proportions and camera angle identical across poses so the sheet can guide a 2D skeletal/sprite animation.
